Subject: PayStream discovery — TCO synthesis & pilot ask

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and the concrete asks so we can move to a pilot decision next week.

Summary of pain & goals (what you said)
- Primary pain: per-request costs are ballooning as PayStream scales routing/verification flows; token bill is the top line concern for your payment flows.
- Latency sensitivity: intermittent spikes (200–400ms) during peak flows cause retries in downstream systems. SLA pressure from ops.
- Compliance: logs and auditability are required but must remain cost-predictable.

Key levers we discussed (what we can do)
- Batching: grouping verification requests into micro-batches to amortize per-token overhead. We estimate 30–50% savings on generator-heavy routes.
- KV/prefix caching: cache recent KVs for repeated authorization context to avoid re-generation; great fit for your repeat-merchant checks.
- Quantization & model selection: run high-frequency inference on a quantized variant for cost, keep higher-precision model for rare edge cases.
- Smart routing/fallbacks: route best-effort low-cost model for non-critical paths, fallback to stronger model only on failure.

Initial TCO snapshot (ballpark)
- Baseline monthly token spend (your number): ~12M tokens/mo for verification + enrichment.
- Redwood pilot projection with batching+cache: ~5–7M tokens/mo equivalent — 40–60% reduction depending on hit rate.
- One-time pilot setup + infra tuning: estimated 2–3 engineering days from PayStream + Redwood support.

Attachments: I attached the brief discovery notes and a draft pilot cost workbook (pilot-cost-estimate.xlsx) that includes scenarios for 20/40/60% batching hit rates.

Next steps (asks)
1) Can you confirm a target pilot window (2–4 weeks) and a hard budget ceiling for the pilot?
2) If procurement needs a short statement of work, we can provide a one-page SOW by EOD tomorrow.
3) Marissa will follow up with a concrete pilot plan + pricing tiers.

If that aligns, we'll aim to have a pilot proposal in your hands by Wednesday.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Connor O'Brien

Connor — thanks, this is very helpful and captures the call. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Budget constraint: we have a tight pilot envelope — we can do up to $18k for a 4-week technical pilot (tools + vendor fees). Anything above that requires leadership sign-off.
- Success criteria: (1) >=35% reduction in token spend on verification routes, (2) mean p50 latency <= 120ms for production-ish load, (3) no audit gap — logs retained for 90 days.
- Timeline: we can kick off a technical pilot the week of Dec 7. Procurement wants an itemized cost table and a minimal SOW.

Aman will coordinate procurement questions, but please make sure the estimate includes line items for dedicated tuning hours.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Platform Engineering | PayStream
elena.martinez@paystream.com

Elena / team — following up with a concrete pilot plan and high-level pricing that fits your $18k envelope. High-level: we can structure a 3-week technical pilot for $15k with an optional 1-week extension for $5k. Details below.

Pilot scope (3 weeks, $15k)
- Week 1: onboarding, infra setup (private routing rules), baseline metrics capture. ~1 engineering day from PayStream, Redwood provides a dedicated solutions engineer.
- Week 2: implement batching + KV cache; tune for hit-rate. Typical hit-rate target for your flows: 35–50%.
- Week 3: run load window, measure p50/p95 latency, token spend, and produce a short TCO report.

Estimated economics (conservative numbers)
- Baseline: 12M tokens/mo -> cost baseline $3,600/mo (at $0.0003/token equivalent for generator-heavy work).
- Pilot projection (35% batching hit, 20% cache hit): ~7.8M tokens/mo -> cost projection $2,340/mo. Immediate monthly savings: ~$1,260 (35%).
- If rollout achieves 50% combined hit, tokens ~6M/mo -> $1,800/mo; savings $1,800/mo vs baseline.

Line items included in the $15k pilot: onboarding, dedicated SRE time (up to 16 hrs), custom batching configs, quantized model build for your routes, 2 evaluation sessions.
- Not included: long-term dedicated capacity commitments, third-party on-prem install time beyond 8 hrs (if needed).

Deliverables
- Pilot runbook and SOW (one page).
- Pilot-cost-estimate.xlsx with scenario tabs (20/35/50% hits).
- Short TCO report and recommended rollout path.

Next asks (what we need to finalize scope)
1) Confirm start week (you mentioned week of Dec 7).
2) Provide a contact in procurement for the PO and any contractual constraints.
3) Any routes you want excluded from batching during pilot (e.g., high-risk fraud flows).

If that fits the $18k envelope, we can start paperwork and lock dates. Happy to jump on a 15-min call to walk procurement through the SOW.

Thanks — Marissa
